name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Package : Insurance Scheme For Health Workers Fighting COVID-19
benefit: - **Insurance Coverage:** ₹50,00,000/- provided in case of death or permanent disability due to COVID-19.- **Risk Coverage:** Covers loss of life due to COVID-19; covers accidental death during COVID-19-related duty.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a healthcare worker; including doctors, nurses, paramedics, and support staff. - The applicant must be directly involved in COVID-19 related duties. - The applicant must be a citizen of India. - The applicant must be working in a COVID-19 designated hospital or care facility. - The applicant must be registered under a government health program.
